How Imagineers Hide Infrastructure at Pandora - The World of Avatar 🏔️ #STEAMweek
Every floating mountain needs a foundation ✨🏔️

Armand, Principal Civil Engineer at Walt Disney Imagineering, shares how infrastructure is hidden within the land at Pandora - The World of Avatar so nothing distracts from the story.

✨ Civil engineering, art, and storytelling work together so guests never see the structure that makes the magic possible.
